title: Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets.
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta.
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry.
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience.
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.

What We Need From You

  • Have excellent business negotiation and market development capabilities, be loyal to business goals, have insight into the needs of users, and be brave to embrace challenges.
  • Have basic data analysis skills and master office software applications. Experience in working with charts/graphs is required.
  • Integrity, honesty and resilience. Passionate about work and possessing a strong team spirit.
  • English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

Inglês intermediário.

title: Sales Operations & Data Analyst
description:
Nossa organização de Operações de Vendas é responsável por construir a melhor estratégia de entrada no mercado para conectar nossas soluções às necessidades dos clientes em escala. Como Analista de Estratégia e Operações de Vendas, você trabalhará em parceria com seus colegas para resolver os tópicos estratégicos mais importantes da organização de vendas, impulsionando o crescimento da receita, melhorando a produtividade das vendas e agregando valor aos clientes.

O analista deve ser altamente adaptável, possuir fortes habilidades de comunicação e ter um histórico comprovado de entrega de análises sem erros em cargos anteriores. O candidato também deve ser capaz de lidar com informações sensíveis, confidenciais e não rotineiras, estar aberto a questionar o status quo e trabalhar em uma organização em rápida transformação, ao mesmo tempo em que inspira excelência em si mesmo(a) e nos parceiros de negócios.

• Participar de um programa global de transformação de operações

Qualificações Básicas

• Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em consultoria de gestão, finanças, operações de vendas, operações de negócios ou em funções analíticas/operacionais

• Proatividade e atitude positiva: busca informações de forma independente, resolve problemas conceituais, mobiliza recursos e entrega resultados em situações desafiadoras e multifacetadas; motivado(a) e engajado(a) para colaborar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante mudança

title: Volunteer Doctor, South Africa
description:
Are you passionate about using your knowledge and skills to help others? Answer your calling, and take your leave of purpose.

The Tshemba Foundation is appealing to international doctors to address a critical health care gap in rural South Africa’s north eastern provinces where doctor shortages are posing substantial challenges to adequate health care.

You will experience and learn from a stimulating and challenging working environment, treat conditions and cases not usually seen in urban areas and help leave a legacy of improved quality of care by sharing knowledge and skills with local staff who are eager for support.

Tshemba offers its volunteers free, safe and secure accommodation at its Volunteer Lodge, situated in Moditlo Private Game Reserve. The Lodge serves as a welcome off-duty refuge where like-minded healthcare providers relax after an intense day of work. Here they exchange ideas, create healthcare solutions for daily challenges faced and connect with peers from all over the world, all the while taking in the magnificent natural surroundings.

In your role as a volunteer doctor you can offer:

  • direct or indirect patient care in various departments of a public hospital and/or surrounding clinics
  • postgraduate support to medical staff in training
  • skills development and/or formal teaching for local staff
  • administrative or management support, including clinical and quality improvement projects
  • develop health interventions and protocols alongside local staff

Our clinical team will work with you to develop a personalized volunteer schedule that combines your skills and experience with the needs of various hospital departments and clinics in the area.

Length of placement:

  • Currently, volunteer placement lengths are flexible based on your area of expertise. We recommend a minimum of 8 weeks for generalist international volunteers and can negotiate shorter stays for specialists. We will work with you to determine where you will be placed and how long your stay will be to have maximum impact.

Requirements:

  • A current license in good standing from your medical regulatory body
  • Registration with ECFMG and the Health Professionals Council of South Africa (HPCSA) which our team will assist you to apply for. Current ECFMG certification will expedite the process.
  • We welcome interest from ALL REGISTERED PHYSICIANS however, the greatest current need are for Radiologists, Family physicians, Geriatricians, Neurologists, Dermatologists, Internists, Psychiatrists, Paediatricians, Gastroenterologists, Ophthalmologists and General Surgeons.

Physicians who have volunteered with Tshemba tell us that they have been re-energized and transformed by the experience, and their passion for medicine reignited.

Please reach out if you have any questions and to discuss volunteering your time.

title: JAMS Automation Engineer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. This role will be responsible for automating repeatable processes in Sompo’s public cloud and on-premise datacenter environments to improve process efficiencies. This role will be responsible for developing, documenting, maintaining, supporting, and optimizing automation workflows. Subject matter expertise is required in Microsoft PowerShell scripting.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, test and validate PowerShell scripts as part of automation workflows and maintain in source control for change management.

• Create and Maintain a Dynamic Inventory of all JAMS Scheduler Jobs.

• Create and maintain a JAMS incident tracker for logging dates and times of all warnings and errors from JAMS Scheduler Jobs as well as escalation and fix details.

• Update Job properties (Schedules, Source Code etc.) as directed by Job owners.

• Proactively review and monitor the health of all JAMS Jobs i.e. daily reviewing output of all jobs.

• Review job failures and take corrective action where possible or escalate to Job owner as necessary.

• Log Service Desk ticket (incident) for all JAMS Scheduler Job failures, provide resolution in collaboration with job owner and maintain incident resolution log\ knowledge base.

• Installation of JAMS Client tools, JAMS software updates and\or reporting tools.

• Liaise with JAMS account representative and Sompo procurement in relation to JAMS Scheduler annual support License renewals.

• Participate in IT projects, responsible for development of automation workflows outlined in the Project Plan and directed by the Project Manager, at whatever level of effort or participation has been defined for them.

• Build, administer, monitor and maintain JAMS Enterprise Scheduler and System Center Orchestrator environments.

• Work with Application team members to evaluate automation workflow needs and requirements.

• Develop integrations between infrastructure systems for data analysis and reporting through REST API calls.

• Maintain JAMS platform, standard operating procedures, perform changes, apply patches, and updates as required.

• Prevent, diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve automation runbook errors.

• Maintain strict change control of the automation infrastructure.

• Continuously identify and report areas of improvement in the automation arena and implement improvements when approved.

• Contribute to on-going research and evaluation of new technologies.

• Responsible for completing other work requirements or tasks that are requested by IT management when necessary to meet the goals and objectives of the department or company.

• Working continuously on a task until completion to ensure business automation workflows remain available 24/7.

• The ability to multitask while ensuring the highest quality of work is maintained.

• Establishing a good working relationship with customers and other IT groups.

• Be able to work independently within established policies and procedures.

• Perform routine tasks unsupervised.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Excellent technical skills including however not limited to Microsoft Operating systems server including PowerShell scripting, Microsoft SQL Server , Microsoft Azure including Logic Apps, JSON Scripting, REST API.

• Azure or AWS Certification is desirable.

• Experience with System Center Orchestrator 2012 or later preferred.

• Experience with JAMS Enterprise Manager is highly desirable and preferred.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong background in an Infrastructure environment with a minimum of 5 years’ experience.

• Team orientated with the ability to multitask and prioritize workloads.

• Very strong problem solving and analytical skills and is a systemic thinker with an attention to detail.

• Seeks to expand knowledge and experience and is committed to continuous learning.

Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Job Description:

  • As a cyber security Business Develop Manager, you will be responsible for all sales of Hillstone security products and solutions through Hillstone authorized channel partners or directly. You will report to Country Manager.
  • The role is predominantly customer facing, requiring ownership of, and an ability to develop, drive and execute all phases of the sales cycle, including but not limited to the identification and qualification of opportunities, high level solution design, solution presentation, commercial negotiation and order processing.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and lead security account plans and strategies using all cross-functional resources (executive sponsors, marketing, technical, services, etc) to achieve your quota.

  • Lives in Sao Paulo-SP
  • Preview experience in sell through by big Telcos B2B, Cyber Security partners and sell to Government;
  • Proven experience in managing and executing all phases of the sales cycle until the closure;
  • Ability to sustain technical sales during the prospecting process.

  • Highly self-motivated and goal oriented, excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills, open minded, willing to listen and learn. Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Hillstone is an equal opportunity employer.

We will only notify shortlisted candidates.

About Us

Founded in 2006 by NetScreen veterans, Hillstone Networks has been a leading innovator in the cybersecurity space. Recognized as a Visionary in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Network Firewalls, Hillstone’s innovative solutions have evolved to match the rapidly changing threat landscape, including the first AI-driven firewall in 2014, and extending these established capabilities into newer products such as the advanced NDR and XDR platforms. Our patented and innovative security architecture, including one of the first multicore firewall, as well as a fully distributed firewall architecture and twin-mode firewall for redundant data centers, have made Hillstone a trusted partner and industry leader. Trusted by over 28,000 customers across 60+ countries, including over 100 of the Fortune 500 customers, Hillstone Networks brings breadth and depth of defenses from edge to cloud, across any workload, protecting against multilayer and multistage cyberattacks.

title: Lider CNC
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global em produtos de cuidados visuais de classe mundial, incluindo óculos icônicos, tecnologia de lentes avançada e soluções digitais de ponta. Nosso trabalho vai além do nosso negócio. Estamos abrindo novas fronteiras, promovendo a inclusão e a colaboração, abraçando a agilidade, acendendo a paixão e causando um impacto positivo no mundo.

Somos o grupo das marcas de cuidados visuais e óculos mais amadas e reconhecidas do mundo. Nosso portfólio incomparável de marcas exclusivas de óculos, como Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear e Costa, é complementado por mais de 20 marcas licenciadas de prestígio. Nossas tecnologias avançadas de lentes incluem a marca Essilor, com Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest e Transitions. O negócio é complementado por plataformas líderes de comércio eletrônico, como Ray-Ban.com, EyeBuyDirect, Clearly e muito mais.

Se interessou? Veja a descrição das atividades e inscreva-se:

O Lider CNC sera responsável por liderar um grupo maior de operadores, fazer a gestão e monitorar máquinas de usinagem de baixa, média e alta complexidade com o objetivo de produzir peças e componentes de alta precisão. Executar o controle das etapas do processo de fabricação (EPM), verificando e validando a realização de cada etapa finalizada, através de um check list pré-estabelecido;

  • Manter a segurança no ambiente de trabalho em todos os aspectos da operação, conforme as orientações e padrões pré-estabelecidos;
  • Garantir o monitoramento da qualidade das peças produzidas, estabelecendo e implementando procedimentos de controle de qualidade

  • Ensino Técnico completo em Mecânica e áreas correlatas;
  • Desejavel Formação superior em Engenharia;
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenho;
  • Conhecimento CAD;
  • Conhecimento nos comandos, OKUMA, FANUC, HEIDENHAIN

  • Convênio Médico e Odontológico
  • VA

title: Analista Comercial Jr. (Precatórios)

title: Gerente de Vendas | Energia Solar
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m2.

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Gerente de Vendas, você irá:

  • Gerenciar soluções de redes inteligentes (smart grid) ao longo de todo o seu ciclo de vida, garantindo que os requisitos dos produtos estejam alinhados às necessidades do mercado e aos objetivos da empresa;
  • Definir as ofertas de produtos, incluindo hardware, software, operações, serviços e modelos de negócios, coordenando atividades entre diversos departamentos;
  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias de entrada no mercado (go-to-market) e planos de lançamento de produtos;
  • Monitorar o desenvolvimento, entrega e status dos serviços das soluções, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos de lançamento, qualidade e alinhamento com o mercado;
  • Liderar a definição de ofertas comerciais para os mercados-alvo, incluindo estratégias de precificação, e acompanhar a rentabilidade dos produtos e serviços;
  • Analisar métricas de desempenho dos produtos para promover melhorias contínuas e garantir o sucesso das soluções.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Graduação ou Pós-graduação, preferencialmente em Engenharia Elétrica;
  • Experiência comprovada em áreas tecnológicas como sistemas de energia, redes elétricas inteligentes (smart grids);
  • Inglês fluente, tanto na forma escrita quanto falada.

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Refeição
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

  • Develop and launch “surprise & delight” initiatives and exclusive benefits to retain and grow loyalty among top users.
  • Conduct UX research and analysis to identify friction points and propose solutions that improve the overall experience.
  • Collaborate with Product and Design teams to prioritize UX enhancements and premium journey flows.
  • Build dashboards and reporting systems to monitor satisfaction, retention, and GMV contribution of top user cohorts.
  • Serve as the internal advocate for top-value users, ensuring their needs are represented in cross-team strategies.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in business, design, engineering, or related fields.
  • Robust experience in user operations, CX, CRM, or growth, preferably with exposure to premium or segmented service strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of UX principles, customer journey design, and service-level differentiation.

title: Principal Architect
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A "Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Additional Information

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Senior Art Director
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

We are seeking an Art Director to join our Branding team and play a pivotal role in crafting creative ads and evolving the visual presence of our brand in Brazil. This position is crucial to ensuring that our campaigns are visually striking and culturally resonant, helping us establish a strong foothold in the Brazilian market. If you are passionate about creating captivating visuals and have experience leading high-level creative projects, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the creative visual concepts for entire campaigns, working closely with the content team.
  • Create impactful key visuals that align with the company's marketing strategies.
  • Create high-conversion ad creatives—such as short videos, image-text formats, interactive ads, and H5 pages—based on user psychology, industry trends, and market hot topics.
  • Lead the development and localization of the brand in Brazil, adapting it to the cultural and aesthetic context of the country.
  • Guide and lead other design team members in various projects, ensuring visual consistency and excellence.
  • Design materials for different channels, including digital media, social networks, websites, print materials, and Out Of Home (OOH) media.
  • Manage the creative process from conception to final production, maintaining deadlines and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure visual guidelines align with brand objectives.
  • Stay updated with design trends, technology, and industry innovations, applying relevant insights to projects.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Marketing, Advertising, Visual Design, Journalism, or related fields;
  • Strong business English communication skills;
  • Proven experience as an Art Director or similar role in crafting visual campaigns and key visuals;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing strategic creative skills and visual aesthetics;
  • Experience in leading and mentoring design teams and collaborating with content strategists;
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian culture, aesthetics, and market trends;
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in dynamic environments;
  • Proficiency in design software and visual creation tools;
  • Excellent communication skills and a strong ability to work as part of a team.

Location: 100% On site - Vila Olimpia, SP

title: IT Service Operations Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Product Testing, Procurement, and System Integration
  • Validate local products based on headquarters' architecture standards and execute procurement and device purchases.
  • Collaborate with headquarters and local service providers for the purchase, installation, configuration, and upgrade of network equipment and low-voltage systems.
  • Manage system integration projects to ensure solutions align with headquarters' technical requirements and optimize execution according to local needs.
  • IT Infrastructure and Network Management
  • Develop and implement localized IT solutions, ensuring maintenance and operations align with headquarters standards.
  • Monitor office network quality using headquarters' tools, gather user feedback, and implement improvements.
  • Track, manage, and inventory local IT infrastructure resources, resolve application issues, and ensure infrastructure integrity.
  • Service Management and Coordination
  • Manage onsite services including desktop operations, IT asset management, and maintenance of public IT services.
  • Coordinate local service provider resources for rapid problem resolution and efficient use of personnel and equipment.
  • Manage service SLAs, track performance, drive improvement projects, and ensure delivery quality.
  • Standard Procedures, Reporting, and Team Management
  • Provide standard operating procedures and documentation support, regularly report progress on localized solutions to headquarters.
  • Understand onsite service needs through employee interviews and ticket analysis, continuously improve IT service and product experiences.
  • Manage service providers and team members, including workforce planning, recruitment, training, performance appraisal, and personnel development.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
  • At least 3 years of experience in IT service management, with overseas work experience preferred.
  • Fluency in both Chinese and English, or Arabic and English, for effective communication is preferred.
  • Familiar with the processes and technologies related to desktop operations, asset management, and conference room operations.Advantage with ITIL and PMP certifications.
  • Excellent communication and team management skills, capable of working in a multicultural environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills、quick response capabilities and project collaboration skills.

title: Assistente comercial
description:
Vaga: Assistente Comercial – STAREX Remoções e Serviços Médicos

Descrição da vaga:

A STAREX busca um(a) Assistente Comercial para atuar de forma estratégica e operacional no setor comercial, contribuindo para a prospecção de novos clientes, manutenção de contratos ativos e apoio direto na expansão da empresa no segmento de remoções médicas e transporte de pacientes. Este(a) profissional será um elo entre a operação, a diretoria e os clientes, garantindo comunicação clara, acompanhamento de indicadores contratuais e suporte em propostas e negociações.

Principais responsabilidades:

Apoiar a diretoria na identificação de novas oportunidades de negócio (mercado público e privado).

Elaborar propostas comerciais, cotações e respostas a solicitações de clientes.

Realizar acompanhamento e controle de contratos em andamento, auxiliando na prevenção de riscos contratuais.

Apoiar em processos de licitação, em conjunto com o setor responsável, garantindo a conformidade dos documentos e prazos.

Monitorar a satisfação de clientes, acompanhando demandas e ocorrências junto à operação e propondo melhorias.

Analisar indicadores de desempenho comercial e preparar relatórios gerenciais.

Atuar em conjunto com o setor de operações e RH para alinhar recursos necessários a novos contratos.

Manter relacionamento próximo com clientes, fortalecendo a imagem institucional da STAREX.

Reunir subsídios para respostas à notificações de descumprimento contratual.

Requisitos:

Formação superior completa ou em andamento em Administração, Gestão Comercial, Direito, ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência em rotinas comerciais B2B, preferencialmente em empresas de serviços terceirizados ou saúde.

Boa comunicação, postura profissional e habilidade de negociação.

Excel intermediário/avançado para controles e relatórios.

Capacidade analítica, organização e atenção a detalhes.

Diferenciais:

Vivência em contratos públicos (licitações, aditivos, prorrogações).

Experiência no setor de saúde ou transporte.

Conhecimento em CRM ou sistemas de gestão comercial.

Salário: R$ 2.800,00

title: Terapeuta Ocupacional
description:
O que você irá fazer:

  • Atendimento clínico e avaliações terapêutico-ocupacionais de idosos e crianças;
  • Evolução de pacientes no sistema;
  • Atualização das rotas domiciliares;
  • Preenchimento de anamnese ocupacional;
  • Alinhamento de informações com equipe multiprofissional;
  • Cumprimento de práticas organizacionais visando a segurança do paciente;
  • Execução de atividades correlatas conforme necessidade da organização;
  • Experiência com atendimento a idosos e crianças;
  • Desejável: experiência com serviço de home care;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas específicas da Terapia Ocupacional;

title: Tax Sr Analyst (Advanced English)
description:
Join Our Team as Tax Sr Analyst – Brazil (São Paulo) Advanced English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Department: Finance LATAM

Reports to: Senior Tax Manager LATAM

Are you a seasoned tax professional ready to lead and make an impact in a global organization? We’re looking for a Tax Sr Analyst to oversee tax compliance and strategic initiatives for our Brazilian entity. This is a fantastic opportunity to work in a dynamic, collaborative environment where your expertise will shape tax operations and support business growth.

What You’ll Do

As Tax Sr Analyst, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading tax compliance for direct and indirect taxes in Brazil.
  • Preparing tax calculations for review by external advisors (EY, Deloitte).
  • Managing deferred tax accounting (IFRS and BRGAAP), including annual and half-year calculations.
  • Overseeing reconciliations for tax GL accounts using SAP and Blackline.
  • Coordinating SPED, municipal obligations (withholding tax), IBGE, and BACEN reporting.
  • Supporting Transfer Pricing processes with external specialists.
  • Advising internal teams on tax treatment for various operations.
  • Staying ahead of regulatory changes, including Brazil’s ongoing Tax Reform.
  • Collaborating with external auditors and tax authorities during audits.
  • Leading a team of 3 direct reports and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Minimum 6 years in Brazilian tax (local & international), tax accounting, and compliance.
  • Education: Degree in Accounting or Tax.
  • Technical Skills: SAP, SPED, HFM (BRACS), Blackline.
  • Tax Expertise: IRPJ, CSLL, ISS, PIS, COFINS, ICMS; knowledge of tax treaties and audit processes.
  • Languages: Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication, analytical mindset, team leadership, and collaboration.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a global company with a strong presence in LATAM.
  • Lead impactful tax projects and contribute to strategic decisions.
  • Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for development and innovation.

title: Mantenedor I
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros.

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

Missão do cargo

Executar rotinas de manutenção preventiva em equipamentos, máquinas e instalações, garantindo seu funcionamento eficiente e prolongando sua vida útil.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar inspeções regulares para identificar falhas ou potenciais problemas nos sistemas mecânicos, elétricos ou hidráulicos.
  • Efetuar reparos imediatos em caso de falhas, substituindo peças defeituosas e realizando ajustes necessários para restabelecer a operacionalidade.
  • Diagnosticar e analisar problemas complexos, utilizando ferramentas e instrumentos adequados para identificar a causa raiz.
  • Atuar na correção de problemas emergenciais, respondendo rapidamente a chamados de manutenção e solucionando questões de forma eficiente.
  • Manter registros precisos das atividades de manutenção, incluindo intervenções realizadas, peças utilizadas e tempo despendido.
  • Colaborar com outros departamentos e equipes para coordenar ações de manutenção e compartilhar informações relevantes.
  • Participar de treinamentos e programas de desenvolvimento profissional para aprimorar habilidades técnicas e manter-se atualizado com as melhores prática

Requisitos

  • EM Completo
  • Conhecimento em Manutenção preventiva
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Ensino técnico (desejável)

Local de trabalho

Brasília/DF -Brasil

A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

title: Analista Pleno de Suporte Técnico (Protheus)
description:
Prestar o suporte técnico aos nossos clientes provendo soluções com empatia, proatividade e garantindo a satisfação dos clientes com os produtos e serviços TOTVS.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Realizar o atendimento aos clientes, por meio dos canais TOTVS, esclarecendo suas dúvidas sobre assuntos referentes ao sistema, registrando sugestões e incidentes;
  • Prestar o atendimento, por meio de canais de abertura de tickets, de acordo com o processo definido e visando ao atendimento e às metas estabelecidas;
  • Registrar, em sistema, a solicitação do cliente com todas as evidências (tickets abertos) de detalhamento necessárias para todos os impactados;
  • Triar os tickets abertos pelo cliente e reclassificá-los ou categorizá-los, quando necessário, pelo tipo de ticket ou status do atendimento;
  • Fornecer status das demandas em evolução, quando solicitado pelo cliente, por meio de canais de atendimento (telefônico, por e-mail, sistema);
  • Escalonar, para o próximo nível, as solicitações ou incidentes que não forem evoluídos, após o esgotamento das possibilidades de solução dentro do tempo estimado pela Coordenação da área;

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação: Superior completo.

Conhecimentos específicos:

  • Suporte Protheus
  • Lógica de programação e noções de banco de dados;
  • Regras de negócio sobre o Protheus;
  • Pacote da Microsoft

Benefícios

  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.

title: Formação em Corretor de Seguros
description:
Quer redirecionar sua carreira profissional, aprender uma nova profissão e iniciar seu próprio negócio? Venha atuar como Corretor de Vida e Previdência na MAG Seguros!

Você ingressará no nosso Programa para Formação de Novos Corretores, onde aprenderá tudo sobre Seguro de Vida e Previdência. Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:

  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;

Após a conquista da Habilitação:

  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;

Você se diferenciará, se possuir:

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.

PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO:

  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields

EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.

COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

title: Kitchen Sales Designer
description:
About the job

We are looking for a talented Kitchen Sales Designer to join our growing team in Latin America. In this role, you’ll help homeowners create kitchens that are both beautiful and practical. You bring a passion for design, sales, and innovation — always keeping the customer at the center. Together with experienced colleagues, you’ll thrive in a dynamic, creative environment.

What is CORNER Renovation?

CORNER is a kitchen brand dedicated to designing and manufacturing high-quality custom kitchens for homeowners worldwide. As a technology-driven company, we develop our own tools to make renovation seamless. With a distributed team in Ukraine and Argentina, and a growing presence across Latin America, we’re expanding quickly and looking for new talent to join us.

Our mission is simple: to help people create the living spaces they dream of. If that resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team.

  • Strong sense of our style, with the ability to translate it into innovative, next-level designs that combine functionality and aesthetics.

  • Flexibility to work with clients across different time zones
  • Experience with SketchUp and V-ray
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, able to drive projects forward independently while maintaining high standards.
  • Good understanding of cabinet construction, hardware and assembly, ensuring designs are practical and production-ready.
  • Proven experience in client-facing roles, with the ability to build trust and guide clients through decision-making
  • 5+ years of work experience in the furniture and kitchen design industry

Responsibilities:

  • Own the entire project cycle, from company presentation to final design.
  • Keep yourself fully updated on our product range, features, and capabilities, while exploring innovative ways to apply them in design solutions.

  • Prepare layouts and design presentations for clients.

  • Communicate with the internal team to ensure alignment across project details, timelines, and client expectations.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project, ensuring clear communication, smooth process, and an excellent client experience.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Professional growth and experience working with international clients
  • Flexible vacation and holiday schedule

title: Technical Service Engineer - Building Materials (Mortar Powder & Coatings)
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled Technical Service Engineer to provide expert technical support and solutions for our Mortar Powder & building material coatings product lines. This role combines hands-on field troubleshooting, customer training, and collaboration with R&D to optimize product performance and ensure customer satisfaction in construction, industrial, and architectural markets.

Responsibilities:

  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting
  • Serve as the primary technical contact for customers, distributors, and sales teams, resolving issues related to product application, performance, and compatibility (e.g., adhesion failure, curing defects, durability concerns).
  • Conduct on-site visits to diagnose problems and recommend solutions for Mortar Powder (e.g., concrete additives, mortar mixes) and coatings (e.g., epoxy, waterproofing, decorative finishes).
  • Product Training & Documentation
  • Develop and deliver technical training programs for customers, contractors, and internal teams on product usage, safety protocols, and best practices.
  • Create detailed technical documentation, including application guides, safety data sheets (SDS), and troubleshooting manuals.
  • Product Optimization & Testing
  • Collaborate with R&D and QA teams to improve product formulations based on field feedback and performance data.
  • Perform lab and field tests to validate product compatibility with substrates (concrete, wood, metal) and environmental conditions (humidity, temperature).
  • Compliance & Sustainability
  • Ensure products meet industry standards (e.g., ISO, ASTM) and environmental regulations (e.g., low VOC, REACH compliance).
  • Advocate for sustainable solutions, such as eco-friendly coatings or recycled sand powder applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Support sales teams by participating in client meetings, demonstrating product value, and addressing technical inquiries during pre- and post-sales phases.
  • Work with supply chain to address logistics or raw material challenges impacting product performance.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., NACE, SSPC) are a plus. 3+ years of experience in technical service, R&D, or application engineering within the building materials, coatings, or construction chemicals industry. Sherwin williams,Sika,etc are preferred.

Required Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of Mortar Powder applications (e.g., cementitious systems) and coating technologies (e.g., epoxy, polyurethane, acrylic).
  • Proficiency in laboratory testing methods, data analysis, and root-cause analysis for product failures.
  • Familiarity with CAD software, simulation tools, or digital tools for technical documentation is advantageous.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with green building certifications (e.g., LEED, BREEAM).
  • Multilingual skills for roles supporting global markets (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin).
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer site visits and industry events.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer (Temporary)
description:
Job Description

About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps or related role.
  • Proficiency in AWS cloud services, specifically IAM, RDS, and EKS.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools, such as Terraform.
  • Strong background in setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools, especially Datadog.
  • Knowledge of SOC2 compliance standards and security best practices.
  • Experience with VPN configuration, Cloud IdP (such as JumpCloud), and network security.
  • Certifications in AWS (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or security (e.g., CISSP) are desirable.
  • Experience with additional cloud providers (e.g., Azure, GCP) is a plus.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation tools (e.g., Python, Bash) is desirable.
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and container orchestration.
  • Advanced english proficiency.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Infrastructure Management: Manage both employee and organizational infrastructure to ensure seamless operations.
  • VPN Configuration & Management: Configure and manage VPN access to secure connections for employees.
  • Cloud Identity Provider (IdP) Management: Oversee JumpCloud or equivalent cloud IDP services for secure user management.
  • Employee Onboarding & Offboarding: Manage workstation setups, configurations, and removals during employee transitions.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement, manage, and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform for streamlined infrastructure deployment.
  • AWS Account & IAM Management: Oversee AWS IAM roles, permissions, and account setups for both employees and applications.
  • Database Cluster Management: Scale and manage database clusters and connectivity using AWS RDS, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Microservices Infrastructure: Maintain and optimize microservices infrastructure on AWS EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service).
  • Monitoring & Alerting: Design and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems with Datadog to ensure proactive issue detection and resolution.
  • Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support efficient, reliable, and secure deployment processes.
  • SOC2 Compliance: Ensure all company data systems meet SOC2 standards and regularly review for compliance adherence.
  • Information and Network Security: Establish, enforce, and enhance network security measures, following industry best practices.
  • Penetration Testing & Audits: Conduct recurring penetration tests and audits as per company policies, addressing vulnerabilities promptly.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*

title: Technical Support Engineer (Java Stack)
description:
We are seeking a skilled and customer-focused On-Site Technical Support Engineer to provide technical expertise for our financial services products, with a focus on credit industry solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong Java development skills, hands-on experience with MySQL, and a proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in real-time. A background in the credit/banking industry and exceptional client communication skills are essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Provide on-site and remote technical support for the financial systems, ensuring minimal downtime and rapid resolution of issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve problems related to Java applications, Redis caching, MySQL databases, and associated middleware.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and implement preventive measures.

System Maintenance & Optimization

  • Monitor system performance, conduct regular health checks, and optimize configurations for Redis, MySQL, and Java applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to deploy patches, updates, and hotfixes in production environments.

Client Communication & Requirements Handling

  • Act as the primary technical liaison between clients and the Chinese teams, transmitting business needs to technical solution arthitect in China.
  • Respond promptly to client operational requests, prioritize tasks, and manage expectations effectively.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

  • Create detailed technical documentation, including incident reports, troubleshooting guides, and best practices.
  • Train clients on system functionalities and operational workflows.

Compliance & Collaboration

  • Ensure solutions adhere to local credit industry regulations (e.g., data security, audit requirements).
  • Work closely with DevOps, QA, and product teams to improve system reliability and user experience.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Java development and debugging (Spring Boot, J2EE, or similar frameworks).
  • Strong experience with MySQL (query optimization, replication, backup/recovery).
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Linux/Unix environments, and scripting (Shell/Python).
  • Knowledge of DevOps tools (Jenkins, Docker) and monitoring systems (Prometheus, Grafana) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Redis (cluster management, performance tuning) is a plus.

Industry Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support or development roles, preferably within the credit, banking, or fintech sectors.
  • Understanding of credit business processes (e.g., loan management, risk assessment, payment systems).

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel frequently for on-site client support.

Language

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications in Java, Redis, MySQL, or cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).
  • Experience with microservices architecture and cloud-native technologies.
  • Knowledge of financial compliance standards (e.g., PCI-DSS, GDPR).
  • Knowledge of credit risk management systems(e.g., FICO, Neurotech).

title: Logistics & Partner Operations Trainee
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Job Responsibilities

  • Manage the onboarding of 3PL (third-party logistics) partners from start to finish.
  • Coordinate compliance checks and make sure all partner documents (e.g. CNPJ, tax records, bank details) meet legal and financial requirements.
  • Work closely with the legal, finance, and operations teams during the process.
  • Keep onboarding guidelines (SOPs) updated and look for ways to make processes more efficient.

Requirements:

  • This position is open to graduates whose graduation dates fall between November 2025 and October 2026.
  • Good English communication for the daily work and contact with foreign team.
  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and process discipline.
  • Experience in logistics, delivery platforms, or shared economy operations is a strong plus.
  • Experience with data analytic tools such as SQL or similar tools.
  • Organization and proactivity, with a great willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us?

  • Join Keeta, a member of Meituan, one of the largest global technology companies shaping the future of delivery, logistics, and local services.
  • Work in a fast-growing business, currently expanding internationally and building its brand in new markets.
  • Gain hands-on experience in recruitment, from sourcing to hiring, in a dynamic, multicultural environment.
  • Work on a team that values mentorship, learning, and innovation on a daily basis.

title: Senior Sales Development Representative
description:
Location: Remote South America (Central Time Zone - USA. 8am - 5pm)

NOTE: Must speak excellent English.

We’re a high-growth recruiting firm trusted by mid-market and venture-backed companies to deliver top-tier talent in Technology, Product Management, and Executive Search. Our model spans contract, contract-to-hire, and direct hire placements, offering clients flexibility, speed, and culture-aligned hiring solutions.

Our sales team is the tip of the spear. We're looking for a Senior Sales Development Representative to help us accelerate growth by setting qualified meetings with decision-makers at fast-moving companies.

The Role

As a Senior SDR, you’ll be responsible for creating high-quality opportunities for our Managing Director through proactive outbound outreach across multiple channels. Your mission: generate meaningful conversations with hiring leaders at mid-market companies (100–5,000 employees) across the U.S.

This role is high-volume, phone-led, and metrics-driven—best suited for someone who thrives in a high-energy environment and knows how to position consulting services in a competitive market.

What You'll Do

  • Own the top of the funnel for all outbound activity across phone, email, and LinkedIn
  • Research and segment leads using ZoomInfo, Crelate, and LinkedIn Premium
  • Execute 100 –120+ cold calls/day, plus daily targeted emails and LinkedIn messaging
  • Book qualified meetings with decision-makers (typically VPs, Directors, and Founders)
  • Track activity and pipeline through SourceWhale and internal CRM systems
  • Partner closely with the Managing Director to ensure meeting quality and ICP alignment
  • Iterate and improve outreach campaigns based on performance metrics and conversion data

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5+ years of SDR experience in a B2B consulting or staffing/recruiting environment
  • Proven success generating meetings with mid-market U.S. clients
  • Mastery of cold calling and sales engagement tools (SourceWhale, ZoomInfo, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of professional services, especially in technology, product, or executive search
  • Confident, curious, and motivated by the challenge of breaking into new accounts
  • Comfortable with high daily activity targets and KPI-driven accountability
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

What You’ll Get

  • Base salary + bonuses with uncapped earning potential
  • Daily mentorship from a Managing Director with deep industry experience
  • Flexible, remote-first work culture with outcome-driven autonomy
  • Access to best-in-class tools to power your outreach and workflow
  • Opportunity to grow into a full-cycle sales or account management role

title: Analista de Tesouraria Sênior Bancária
description:
Sobre a Bip

Nascida em Milão no ano de 2003, temos uma história de crescimento exponencial. De 44 pessoas, hoje somos mais de 4500 em todo o mundo, presentes em 4 continentes e em mais de 14 países. Ao longo de todos esses anos crescemos significativamente e transformamos milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho!

Somos guiados por três grandes sonhos...

I. Ser a empresa que sempre sonhamos e que sonhamos para sempre

Espelha o desejo de evolução constante e perenizarão da empresa através de uma cultura forte centrada em pessoas e que essas pessoas pratiquem constantemente a ownership. Que para nós significa liberdade com autonomia de dono e responsabilidade pelo futuro da organização.

II. Presente em ecossistema inovador

Significa ter e desenvolver constantemente, internamente ou através de parceiros, soluções inovadoras que promovam impactos em nossos clientes e que sejam o pilar de nossa perenidade. Pois só um repensar constante nos manterá atuantes no mercado.

III. Socialmente Engajada

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

Nossos benefícios são flexíveis e você poderá distribuí-los de acordo com suas necessidades e interesses:

  • All Points (Programa de pontos para passagens áreas e hospedagens)
  • Assistência Médica

  • Seguro de vida
  • Meu Pet Club

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Tesouraria Sênior para atuar em uma instituição financeira, com foco na gestão dos resultados da tesouraria, análise de riscos e suporte à estratégia de investimentos e operações de mercado financeiro.

  • Analisar e acompanhar os resultados da tesouraria, com segregação por book;
  • Apoiar o controle e monitoramento de instrumentos financeiros (derivativos, TVM, etc.);

  • Ser organizado;

  • senso de urgência;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Ter senso de equipe;

  • Experiência anterior com implementação do sistema Squadra.

Vaga também para PcD

Faça parte da BIP: Um ecossistema inovador, humano, ousado e revolucionário.

Com nosso espírito jovem, vivemos em um ecossistema em evolução que entrega transformação significativa por meio de uma abordagem personalizada.

Por aqui, não falta oportunidade para você crescer.

+40 países de atuação + 5000 Bipers pelo mundo +700 projetos no mercado

Tudo o que temos e construímos para um futuro que se aproxima, é guiado pelo nosso

Pursuing Changes, Nurturing Progress

A mudança é a base de nossa mentalidade, aprendemos e reaprendemos constantemente. Somos desafiadores, assumimos o risco de explorar novas formas de tornar as coisas melhores, inovadoras e sustentáveis para nós, para os nossos clientes e para a sociedade a qual pertencemos. title: Information Technology Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: On-Site IT Support Engineer

Location : Sao paulo Brazil (Onsite)

Duration : 3 months Contract (extendable)

Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.

Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.

Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.

Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.

Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.

Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.

Expected Results

Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.

Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.

Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.

Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.

Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.

Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.

Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.

Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.

Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.

Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

Reconhecidos 3 vezes pelo Great Place to WorkTM, temos uma cultura forte, baseada em inovação, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade e respeito.

Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, essa vaga pode ser sua!

Essa posição é para o profissional compor o time do Security Center como DevSecOps em Brasília, DF.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Neste papel, você vai atuar principalmente no desenvolvimento de APIs, automações, integração de sistemas e esteiras CI/CD, com foco em performance, confiabilidade e boas práticas de segurança.

Dentro do time suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Desenvolvimento e Automação
  • Criar e manter APIs, serviços e ferramentas internas voltadas para automação de processos de TI e segurança;
  • Construir e manter pipelines CI/CD eficientes e reutilizáveis com foco em agilidade e rastreabilidade;
  • Desenvolver integrações com sistemas internos e externos (ex: plataformas de monitoramento, bancos de dados, serviços em nuvem);
  • Automatizar tarefas com scripts e workflows (Python, Node.js, Shell, etc.);
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e colaborar com o time de engenharia em melhorias de arquitetura.
  • Garantir que as esteiras CI/CD incluam validações básicas de segurança (SAST, secret scanning, lint, etc.);
  • Apoiar no controle de acesso e autenticação entre serviços (OAuth2, JWT, API Keys, etc.);
  • Auxiliar na implementação de práticas seguras no ciclo de desenvolvimento (ex: validação de entrada, logs estruturados, gestão de segredos);
  • Colaborar pontualmente com times de segurança na integração de ferramentas e coleta de evidências para auditoria ou resposta a incidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Análise e desenvolvimento de sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia ou área relacionada.
  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento back end (ex: Python, Node.js, Go ou similares);
  • Conhecimento sólido em construção de pipelines CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Vivência com containers (Docker), Kubernetes, e versionamento com Git;
  • Familiaridade com automação de tarefas e integração de APIs;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais ou NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com sistema operacional Linux e Virtualização.

É um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Conhecimentos básicos de segurança em aplicações web (OWASP, autenticação segura, etc.);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação como Ansible, Terraform ou similares;
  • Noções de práticas DevOps/SRE: observabilidade, logging estruturado;
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de gestão de segredos (Vault, Doppler, AWS Secrets Manager).

E aí, deu match!? Então vem fazer parte do nosso time de secpowers!
